source: GDD gdd/lanebound-champions-v4.0-notion.md (Lanebound v4.0, L7 kit); look from champions/portraits/painted/tolle/tolle-1024.png (CD-7)
note: Blue faces right and red faces left. Blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Team tint only on the harness clasp. The slicker is a grey slate, far from team blue #4DA3FF; coral tag is a 2 px accent, not team red. Every hit is the bucket on its chain: the chain is drawn as world-space links from the hand to the bail.

idle.note: breath; bucket sways on its chain, lid on the back

attack.note: bucket swing (melee 1.5): back, over, bucket lands on 3

cast.note: generic cast: bucket lifted to the chest, water drips

wellfed.note: Passive Well-Fed: after a Lock/Bind lands, water drops arc into the bucket and she heals 25 + 2% max HP

slam.note: Q Bucket Slam: swing back (1), over the top (2), out on the chain (3); bucket lands 2.2 tiles out on 4 (0.28 s cast); hit-stop 4-6; r 1.6 stun 0.9 s; chain reels in 7-9

drawdown.note: W Draw Down: swing (1-2), hurl the bucket on the chain on 3 (0.20 s cast), chain taut 4-6, yank 7, bucket back 8; target (ally or enemy) drops into a well mouth: banish 1.8 s

upwelling.note: R Upwelling: bucket hauled overhead (1), upended (2), driven mouth-down into the ground at her feet on 4 (0.40 s cast); a water crack runs to the r 3.4 ring at up to 7 tiles; erupts 0.8 s after the cast: knockup 1.1 s

death.note: bucket drops, kneel, fall; last frame holds

stun.note: Q: stun 0.9 s, shared stun plate

banish.note: W: banish 1.8 s: unit sinks into a well mouth, NEW banish plate floats over the mouth; a water spout returns it

knockup.note: R: knockup 1.1 s on a geyser, stun plate
